P1.finding: a served attempt with a missing model-requests/ summarized as an empty served summary and counted zero
P1.fix: cli/binding/requests.rs::coverage reports unknown for a missing directory, served or not; only the pre-created, synced directory proves a count
P1.absence_paths_rechecked: requests::coverage is the only place a missing directory or file becomes coverage; persist, recovery, inspect and the repair step count all read it. A missing lineage-draw.json reports the reservation. brokered::Summary::observed counts an empty index range as zero only inside a retained directory; a repair step's own broker writes into the directory its prepare created.

P2.finding: RecordedRoute::admit accepted a reused index because RequestFiles accepted an identical existing intent
P2.fix: RequestEvidence::create_intent is create-only, RequestFiles refuses any existing intent, and RecordedRoute admits only indices above the highest it admitted, all before any ticket

kiln_compatibility.finding: Kiln has no consumer of budget_lineage.usage[] (charged or provenance) at this revision, so neither host_measured provenance nor a charge below the reservation is refused. CHARGED_DIMENSIONS (crates/kiln-adapter-lattice/src/lineage.rs:33) gates only the request-side lineage it derives (lineage.rs:358-367, a positive held amount per charged dimension). The worker inventory decodes model_requests as opaque JSON (crates/kiln-adapter-lattice/src/worker_inventory.rs:591), worker_metrics.rs reports usage as NotInstrumented, and worker_settlement.rs:273 classify_observation reads only schema, envelope, dispatch_plan and status.
kiln_compatibility.kiln_change_needed: none for compatibility; Kiln #6/#24 still need a consumer that reads budget_lineage.usage[].charged as the authoritative draw and budget_lineage.usage[].provenance
